item.title: North Schuylkill Sweeps Mahanoy Area in Dual Swim Meet
item.description: North Schuylkill and Mahanoy Area both turned in notable performances Thursday night during a high school swimming dual meet at North Schuylkill Junior/Senior High School, with the Spartans earning the team victories on both the girls’ and boys’ sides. North Schuylkill claimed a 108–50 win in the girls’ meet and followed with a 121–8 victory in the boys’ competition, using depth across individual events and relays to build a steady scoring advantage. item.title: Schuylkill County Students Earn Academic Honors at Commonwealth University
item.description: Commonwealth University has announced its Fall 2025 Dean’s List and President’s List, with numerous students from across Schuylkill County earning recognition for their academic achievement. item.title: Registered Schuylkill County Sex Offender Taken Into Custody Following Megan’s Law Violation Charge
item.description: A registered Tier 2 sex offender previously sought by West Mahanoy Township Police has been taken into custody, according to court records. Michael Blanco Jr. was arrested on Wednesday, January 14, 2026, in connection with a Megan’s Law violation stemming from his alleged failure to verify his address as required under Pennsylvania law. item.description: The Schuylkill County Chapter No. 25 of the National Football Foundation (NFF) and College Hall of Fame has announced the Football Scholar-Athletes who will be honored at its 65th Annual Football Scholar-Athlete Banquet. item.title: Interstate 78 Closed in Both Directions After Multi-Vehicle Pile Up in Berks County
item.description: Interstate 78 is closed in both directions in Berks County following a multi-vehicle crash Saturday morning, according to Pennsylvania State Police. State police report that a 12-vehicle crash occurred on Interstate 78 at mile marker 39.1 in Greenwich Township near Lenhartsville. The crash involved four commercial vehicles and eight passenger vehicles. Emergency crews were dispatched to the scene at 7:51 a.m. and are currently assisting with vehicle extrication efforts.
